q: What is the key difference between a chat tool like ChatGPT and an agent like Hermes?
options: An agent runs in a browser
A chat tool works, while an agent only answers
An agent takes an instruction, uses tools, and completes a job; a chat tool gives a reply and stops
An agent charges more than a chat tool
explanation: ChatGPT answers; an agent works. An agent plans, calls tools, observes results, and repeats until the goal is done, rather than stopping after a single reply.

q: Your agent reads and manages your email via IMAP/SMTP. What is the rule about sending?
options: It sends anything it drafts automatically
Nothing sends without your approval
It can only read, never draft
It forwards everything to your boss first
explanation: The agent drafts replies in your voice, but nothing sends without your approval, so you stay in control of what goes out.

q: How does your agent reach you on Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, and Slack?
options: Through a separate app you must install
It can only email you
Through the messaging gateway connecting 21+ platforms
It cannot message you on any platform
explanation: Hermes has a messaging gateway that connects 21+ platforms, so the same agent delivers messages and scheduled briefings in the apps you already use.

q: What makes Hermes improve at your work across sessions?
options: It forgets everything after each task
Its persistent memory, its own reusable skills, and recall of past sessions
A bigger email inbox
More typing from you
explanation: Hermes has persistent memory across sessions, creates its own reusable skills, and recalls past work, so it remembers who you are and gets better over time.

q: Which of these is a realistic task your agent could handle while you sleep?
options: Running a scheduled job via cron that monitors funding and fellowship opportunities
Manually typing up yesterday's notes
Emptying your physical letter box
None of the above
explanation: The agent schedules via cron and can monitor opportunities, prepare briefings, or run workflows on a schedule, then message you the results in the morning.
